meal.title: Import the random module
meal.objective: You can bring the random module into your program

voice.script: What makes a computer choose rock, paper, or scissors? How do you bring random numbers into a program? To let it pick unpredictably we need random numbers. Python provides bundles of ready-made tools called modules. Importing one is how you bring its tools into your program. The random module supplies functions that generate random values. To use it, write import random at the top of your file. Now the program can call random functions later. Importing a module makes its functions available in your code. Try adding import random to a new file and run it.
